purpose: Diagnostic-only 14-notice probe for the isolated v2 decision-card effect; it cannot rank a canonical policy.
selection_contract: Includes all seven dev v2-positive notices only to measure recall on the complete available v2-positive set.
Includes seven v2-negative notices selected without model outputs, documents, evidence, or other labels: ascending SHA-256 of 'v2-card-probe-v1:<id>'.
The panel is frozen. Its labels may be used for evaluation and cohort composition, never to write or edit the v2 card.
